description: Regional Aviation Rethought! As a part of the emerging industry of Advanced and Regional Air Mobility, Manta Aircraft is developing an innovative and evolutive long-range eV/STOL air mobility platform to tackle 2 markets: > The one of the HELICOPTERS, existing and well known down to the details. We offer a very convenient alternative to helicopters, allowing "backgarden-to-backgarden" travel and a new type of flight services for private/public > and DEFENSE sectors in the urban and regional airspace. The vehicles are responding to real needs of specific industries, are designed for the roles of surveillance, rapid intervention (eg. disaster/emergency response), transportation of specialty material and persons, in the civil and defence environments - and are ready to evolve to new markets performing new types of missions. Key points of the programme: > eV/STOL: Vertical and Short Take-Off and Landing. The short take off option offers to triplicate the range > Long ranges 200-500+ miles (300-800+ km) at high speed 155-186mph (250 - 300 km/h), making it the eV/STOL combination with the longest range > Development of a platform as the base to generate multiple models (2-Seater, 4-Seater, 6-Seater, Cargo-Version, Unmanned/UAV) > Highly adaptable and reconfigurable for several different missions > A fraction of the operating costs of a comparable helicopter > Go-to-market strategy staggered in alignment with the certification steps, for a quicker ROI > An extremely experienced and qualified team, which accomplished more than 20 aircraft certifications (airplanes & helicopters): https://www.mantaaircraft.com/team > Scalability: easy global deployment, versioning for a wide range of use cases, aftermarket and technology revenues beyond aircraft sales. Regarding Manta's USP and differentiation in the market, I would like to highlight three key attributes: > Design - Optimised for vertical flight and for cruise as there are 4 propellers in the fuselage optimized for the vertical flight and 4 in the wings optimzed for cruise; > Hybrid Propulsion System - the turbo-generator allows the aircraft to cover long distances at high speed, whilst avoiding the need for special ground infrastructure like runways or for battery recharging stations, while the battery provides the energy to cover peak demanding situations like the vertical take off and landing > Modularity - Same subsystems used across multiple models, thus minimizing the cost of versioning, maximizing synergies and allowing for scaling up quickly as the aircraft could be assembled in several locations globally. The performance combination of Manta Aircraft provides executive advantages over helicopters, eVTOL air taxis, airplanes and drones. The accurate/verified design, the use of existing technology and off the shelf solutions where possible, the platform approach and the creation of assets along the development process are elements that de-risk the project.

name: Maritime Fusion
description: Fusion reactors for ships Maritime Fusion is building fusion reactors for ships and off grid energy markets. En route on this endeavor we’re commercializing High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) cable technology for power distribution while advancing the physics basis of our HTS tokamak to decarbonize global shipping. Breakeven fusion is coming soon, but the first-of-a-kind (FOAK) reactors will be costly, high maintenance, and have low capacity factors, leading to 5–10x higher electricity cost on the grid. Maritime Fusion is pursuing the most widely accepted approach to fusion, the tokamak, but specifically designed for the marine environment where the challenges that arise between breakeven and a commercially viable energy source are alleviated. The market we're targeting requires 15x less power, lower up-time, and costs the same as alternative fuels but without any emissions. Since fusion does not use highly radioactive fuels or materials – unlike fission – we sidestep the vast majority of regulatory challenges and safety risks associated with nuclear energy. Our team brings over a decade of industry and research experience in plasma physics, nuclear engineering, and electrical engineering with backgrounds at SpaceX, Tesla, Columbia University, and University of Pennsylvania.
description_alternates: Maritime Fusion is building the first nuclear fusion reactors for marine applications, using compact high-temperature superconducting technology to power shipping vessels. Masterpiece provides short term working capital to data vendors that sell training data, evaluation work, and reinforcement learning environments to frontier AI labs. A major financing gap exists in this market. Data vendors often need to pay contributors and fund operations before a lab has completed QA, accepted the work, and paid the invoice. description: Mechanical Orchard is leading one of the biggest — yet quietly dramatic — tech transformations imaginable. With the help of AI, they're migrating the vast stores of data trapped inside mainframes to the cloud. And they couldn't have picked a better time. The developers who can communicate with mainframes in legacy language COBOL are literally retiring. And the many enormous companies that depend on these machines are missing out on the AI revolution that could change their businesses. Exactly how many companies and dollars are impacted? We were shocked to learn that $13 trillion of the U.S. economy relies on mainframe systems today. 71% of the Fortune 500 needs them to function, and collectively spends more than $20B annually buying and maintaining them. 44 out of the top 50 banks, 10 out of 10 top insurers, 23 out of 25 top retailers. All mainframes. Every time you swipe your credit card or buy an airplane ticket. All of it hinges on layers upon layers of spaghetti code, totally inscrutable inside these big, beige, humming boxes. But with Mechanical Orchard, this will soon change. AI is making it possible to move vital data safely and effectively without disrupting critical operations. The company is able to comprehend the byzantine code inside mainframes, decipher what's active, what's dead, what should be moved, and what should be left. The AI then makes it easy for their engineers to rebuild cleaner and more versatile versions of necessary data on the cloud. Mechanical Orchard is led by Rob Mee, hailed founder of Pivotal Labs, who's now applying all his experience combining software and services to deliver excellent outcomes in new ways. Already, the company is working with massive, multi-national customers, helping them work with their data much more easily, take advantage of opportunities unlocked by AI, and integrate new revenue models (all with greater transparency and control). name: Mediachain
description: The goal of Mine is to make metadata for digital images persistent and discoverable anywhere images exist. Today, information about an image, such as authorship or context, is quickly lost as it is shared across the internet. An image may start its life illustrating a news article on the New York Times, annotated with the photographers name and an insightful caption, but it quickly gets stripped down of any valuable context as it propagates different channels of the internet. We effectively know less about an image as it goes viral and reaches more people Mine wants to leverage the phenomenon of social image sharing in the production of a visual knowledge project. Mine uses computer vision to connect the thousands of different appearances of an image, over a thousand contexts and across any platform into one source image: where everything about that image can be collected and known. The entire ripple an image makes across the world is shown under one heading and the Mine community filters what information is most important. Our goal is to disinter mediate media consumption and interaction, which today relies on centralized platforms such as Facebook and Twitter which monetize their users and all the content that flows through them with little benefit to the communities that create that value. This is why we are building our dataset on top of the blockchain, the same technology that enabled two people to exchange a financial asset with no middleman in the case of Bitcoin. We have specified a proposal for our open dataset in the Canonical Content Registry: https://github.com/mine-code/canonical-content-registry

We’re beginning with hands-on deployments, learning how each company works and where people depend on one another. That understanding will let Memoir expand beyond product releases to customer commitments, business decisions, and changes across departments. The idea grew from conversations with product marketers struggling to keep up with engineering, and the possibility of extending a proactive personal AI teammate to an entire business. description: AI powered ERP for Construction Merlin is an AI-powered ERP for construction companies. We provide construction companies with a single, AI-powered platform to manage their entire business operations. Our platform unifies project management, materials management, finance, estimating, and CRM—traditionally scattered across multiple systems—into one cohesive solution. For the first time, construction firms can automate and oversee every aspect of their projects in a single, intuitive system. Today, construction companies pay for 8-17 different tools - that we eliminate the need for. We reduce - Manual work by 60% - Cut software costs by $10,000 monthly - Complete projects 3x faster. Why Now? We're witnessing a perfect storm of factors: decades of stagnation in traditional ERP systems, a multi-billion-dollar industry built on misaligned incentives, and the transformative potential of AI. This confluence creates a rare cyclical opportunity for market upheaval. The last major shift in this space occurred in the 1990s with the advent of digital systems, and now, 30 years later, we're on the cusp of another seismic change. Customers are crying out for innovation and as AI reshapes the landscape, early customer signals indicate an eagerness for smarter, more efficient systems. It's a unique window of opportunity that opens perhaps once in a multi-decade chance to redefine an entire industry's operational backbone. Team: KS, a BITS Pilani grad and successful startup co-founder, and Ayantika, an IIT alumni and tech expert, bring extensive coding and product development expertise together bringing about over a decade of technical expertise. Sneha ( that’s me), with over a decade of experience in supply chain management and lean manufacturing within the construction industry, has lived the pain of using ERPs in this industry.

However, as our dependence on GPS grows, geopolitical tensions and the rise of new technologies like autonomous systems are exposing its limitations. Governments worldwide are now seeking alternative solutions. Enter Mesa Quantum: they’re developing next-generation chip-scale atomic clocks that aim to reduce our critical reliance on GPS, while ensuring we have GPS capabilities all the time…everywhere. Mesa Quantum has developed low cost, chip-scale atomic clock that can seamlessly be integrated into existing electronic boards. They do this through a quantum technology developed at the University of Colorado, Boulder, which is one of the world leading universities in Quantum technologies. Their chips are 10 times better, 10 times smaller and 100 times less expensive to manufacture than the state of the art technologies in this critical time keeping application.

description: M etabolic Psychiatry Labs treats serious mental illness through metabolism. People with conditions like bipolar disorder, major depression and schizophrenia often also struggle with obesity, insulin resistance and other metabolic problems, and each condition makes the other worse. Standard care treats the two separately, and psychiatric medication alone often has limited effect. The company runs a remote care program that combines psychiatric treatment with personalized metabolic interventions: diet, including ketogenic approaches, supplements and medication adjustments. Patients are monitored through an app that tracks lab results, glucose and ketone levels and mental health measures, and the data guides each person’s treatment. The company was founded by Dr. Shebani Sethi, who pioneered the field of metabolic psychiatry at Stanford, and is based in Menlo Park, California.
description_alternates: Metabolism-driven mental health care, personalized and remote Metabolic Psychiatry Labs delivers integrated mental health care that targets root metabolic drivers like insulin resistance, inflammation, and nutrition. Patients use connected at-home devices and a secure mobile app for daily mood, sleep, and energy tracking, plus coordinated remote lab testing and video visits. Board-certified psychiatric and metabolic specialists personalize treatment plans that combine medication management, nutrition interventions, and ongoing monitoring.

name: Metabolize
description: H eadquartered in San Francisco, Metabolize is building a new category of precision metabolite products for weight management. GLP-1 drugs have changed how people lose weight, but most patients stop treatment at some point because of cost, side effects or access, and most of the weight comes back. There is no clear standard of care for this phase, and as GLP-1 use keeps growing, more people are reaching it every year. The company’s first product, NatLean, is a dietary supplement designed to help people keep the weight off after stopping GLP-1 therapy. It is based on metabolites the body already produces, which regulate appetite and metabolism through pathways different from GLP-1.
description_alternates: Sustainable Weight and Metabolic Health - For Everyone, Everywhere Metabolize’s NatLean is a precision metabolite designed to restore natural satiety signaling after GLP-1 medications fade. It delivers endogenous molecules that communicate fullness and energy sufficiency without overstimulating the body. The approach is informed by recent human metabolism research published in Cell and Nature.

name: Mighty Buildings
description: 3D printing beautiful, high-quality, and sustainable homes. Mighty Buildings is an innovative construction technology company based in Oakland, CA creating beautiful, sustainable, and high-quality homes using 3d-printing, robotics, and automation. Their mission is to have a positive impact on the environment, local communities, and the housing crisis through their sustainable approach. Mighty Buildings' technology has the potential to unlock the needed productivity for large scale construction alongside the opportunity for reduced emissions, leading to a more sustainable product and future. Mighty Buildings was founded by a team of physicists and robotics engineers with extensive experience solving hard R&D problems and building successful engineering firms. They started by inventing a new material that is a 3D printing tech that enabled printing of an entire building, not just walls, in a single cycle. Unlike concrete, Mighty Buildings’ material is lighter, can be uniquely treated (trimmed and cut) by robotic arms, and features high thermal insulation properties. This allows them to produce prefab housing with up to 80% of operations automated. Mighty Buildings has a near-zero waste production process, preventing 1,100 - 2,000 kg of CO2 emission per 3D-printed home. They are committed to achieving Net-Zero by 2028 - making the company 22 years ahead of the construction industry. The company is certified under California's Factory Built Housing program to build units using 3D-printing, but they are also the first company to achieve certification under the UL 3401 standard for evaluating building structures and assemblies.
description_alternates: Mighty Buildings is using innovative material science, robotics, and automation to make carbon-neutral housing a reality for everyone. The company aims to disrupt the construction industry with 3D printing tech, robotics, and composite materials.

description: Solid-state heating and cooling systems at a building scale Heating and cooling make up the majority of energy consumption in buildings, representing over 40% of energy-related greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. MIMiC employs advanced solid-state heat pumps, known as thermoelectric devices, combined with innovations in power electronics and controls. This approach not only boosts system efficiency but also fully eliminates the need for environmentally harmful refrigerants. The technology is particularly advantageous for retrofitting residential buildings, streamlining the installation process to save both time and labor costs. Moreover, by significantly reducing the number of moving parts, MIMiC’s solution extends the operational lifetime of heating and cooling systems, marking a significant step forward in reducing the environmental impact of building climate control.

name: Mindgrove Technologies
description: Mindgrove designs cost-effective and scalable microprocessor technology in India for the global semiconductor market. The company designs System-on-Chips (SoCs), which are integrated circuits that combine all the elements of an electronic device onto a single chip instead of separate components. Semiconductors are used in nearly every industry, from healthcare and communications to transportation and military systems, as well as clean energy. It’s a market that is expected to become a trillion-dollar industry by 2030. While the semiconductor industry has grown in the last two decades, the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the importance of these semiconductors more than ever before – a supply crunch in semiconductor production drove massive delays across nearly all manufacturing industries, from cars to computers. SoCs typically require a lot of power to perform well in devices. Mindgrove’s SoCs offer high performance with low power, making the chips ideal for use in applications where power usage may be constrained, such as consumer electronics and aviation. The company’s chips are based on Shakti, a core microprocessor that is among India’s first industrial-grade microprocessors. Mindgrove was born out of a collaboration between the government, academia, and the startup industry at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras. name: Minro
description: Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale Minro helps companies stay close to their users as they scale. Today, most startups have thousands of product events flowing through tools like PostHog, but still have no real understanding of who their users actually are, which users are quietly about to churn, or what outreach actually brings them back. Founders care deeply about their users, but staying close to them becomes operationally impossible very quickly. Minro plugs directly into a company’s analytics stack and turns product activity into living customer intelligence. We enrich every user with context like their company, role, LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter, background, and likely use case, currently matching users to the correct online identity with ~80% accuracy starting from just name + email. We then identify which users are most likely to churn based on behavioral patterns, persona similarity, and historical retention signals, and help founders proactively reach out before those users disappear. Minro drafts highly contextual founder-style outreach, tracks which conversations actually convert into retention, and continuously improves the system over time. The result is a customer intelligence and retention layer that helps companies understand their users better, build stronger relationships, and reduce churn before it happens.
